```{r penguins}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
summary(penguins)
nrow(penguins)
ncol(penguins)
``` 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE)
```
#a logical evaluating to TRUE or FALSE indicating whether NA values should be stripped before the computation proceeds.

EXTRA

* The mean of the sample is `r mean(pull(la_df, norm_samp))`
* The median of the sample is `r median(pull(la_df, norm_samp))`
* The standard deviation of the sample is `r sd(pull(la_df, norm_samp))`

In this dataset, the names of variables include species, island, bill length (mm), bill depth (mm), flipper length (mm), body mass (g), sex, and year

There are 344 rows and 8 columns.
